name: Roof Piece
description: One piece of the kit, weathered and jointed, as a Rhino mesh. A few seconds at 40 mm; minutes at 12.

inputParameters.name: brief
inputParameters.description: The same brief Roof Design used.

inputParameters.name: name
inputParameters.description: A piece's name, from Roof Design's names. Defaults to the first.

inputParameters.name: voxel
inputParameters.description: Sample spacing, mm. Defaults to the brief's. 40 to look, 10 to 15 to make.

inputParameters.name: run
inputParameters.description: False holds the last result while you change things upstream. Unwired, it runs.

outputParameters.name: mesh
outputParameters.description: The piece, weathered, with its dowel sockets.

outputParameters.name: report
outputParameters.description: Size, dowels, triangles, watertight, and beam depth for nodes and beams.
